items.title: Milton Batiste Interview, 1997-02-05
items.q: I love the way Clifford played.

ctx.x: My mind is there. My mind is there. Because I was a youngster there, you know? So I play right now. I don't know what people see about my playing. I don't care because I play myself. I don't like to imitate nobody. My thoughts are my thoughts. Some of my idols was Alvin Alcorn, locally. Again, Wallace, Tompott, Emory Thompson, Clifford Brown. I love the way Clifford played. I love some other Howard McGee, Cat Anderson. All these guys I like. I like to hear them. I like to, some of the things they do, I like to…
How do you differentiate? What are you doing different, you know?
